title.zh: 串联与并联 · 电流的分与合
title.en: Series & Parallel · Splitting and Merging Current

desc.zh: 一条河上两个水闸首尾相接是串联，河水分成两条支流再汇合是并联——电流和电压分别怎样分？粒子流速画出来。
desc.en: Two sluice gates on one river end to end are in series; a river that splits into two branches and rejoins is in parallel — how do current and voltage divide? The flowing dots show it.
